speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I am Dr. Agent. Since you are a newborn, I need to know your age in hours or days and if you have had any fever, poor feeding, or breathing difficulties. Please also tell me if anyone in your home has been sick recently.

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Syphilis.

Given the lack of prenatal care and immunization records, I must rule out congenital infections. Has the mother had any history of rashes, sores, or flu-like symptoms during her pregnancy?
